title: Legal English: Contracts
completion_message: ¡Magistral! El inglés legal (Legalese) es notorio por su complejidad y precisión. Entender términos como 'indemnification', 'severability' o 'force majeure' te permitirá navegar con seguridad al negociar contratos internacionales.

parts.visual:
1. Indemnification (Indemnización/Exención de responsabilidad). 
Ej: The supplier agrees to indemnify the buyer against any third-party claims. (Proteger de daños financieros). 

2. Severability (Divisibilidad). 
- Una cláusula que indica que si una parte del contrato es declarada ilegal o inválida, el resto del contrato sigue vigente. 
Ej: The severability clause ensures the contract survives even if one section is voided. 

3. Force Majeure (Fuerza mayor). 
- Exime a ambas partes de responsabilidad en caso de eventos imprevisibles e inevitables (desastres naturales, guerras).
parts.audio: Number 1: Indemnification. This means to secure someone against legal responsibility or to compensate for harm or loss. For example: The supplier agrees to indemnify the buyer against any third-party claims. Number 2: Severability. A severability clause states that if one part of the contract is deemed illegal or unenforceable, the rest of the contract remains valid. For example: The severability clause ensures the contract survives even if one section is voided. Number 3: Force Majeure. This frees both parties from liability when an extraordinary event or circumstance beyond their control occurs.

parts.visual:
4. Breach of Contract (Incumplimiento de contrato). 
Ej: Failing to deliver the goods on time constitutes a material breach of contract. 

5. Non-Disclosure Agreement / NDA (Acuerdo de confidencialidad). 
Ej: You must sign an NDA before we show you the prototype. 

6. Hereby / Herein / Hereto (Por la presente / En este documento / A esto). 
- Palabras formales usadas en 'Legalese'. 
Ej: The parties hereto agree... (Las partes de este contrato acuerdan...). 

7. Binding (Vinculante / Obligatorio por ley). 
Ej: This document is a legally binding agreement.
parts.audio: Number 4: Breach of Contract. This is a legal cause of action and a type of civil wrong in which a binding agreement is not honored. For example: Failing to deliver the goods on time constitutes a material breach of contract. Number 5: Non-Disclosure Agreement, or NDA. A confidentiality agreement. Number 6: Formal legal words like Hereby, Herein, and Hereto. For example: The parties hereto agree... which means the parties to this document agree. Number 7: Binding. This means involving an obligation that cannot be broken. For example: This document is a legally binding agreement.

questions.question: The ____ clause ensures that if one paragraph is illegal, the rest of the contract is still valid. (Divisibilidad).
Due to the earthquake, the company invoked the ____ clause to delay delivery without penalty. (Fuerza mayor).
The contractor agrees to ____ the company against any lawsuits from third parties. (Indemnizar / Proteger legalmente).
If you share the source code with anyone, it will be considered a material ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: Once both parties sign, this document becomes a legally ____ agreement. (Vinculante).
Before we reveal our trade secrets, you must sign a Non-____ Agreement. (Confidencialidad).
The parties ____ agree to the terms and conditions set forth below. (A este documento/acto).
questions.explanation: The parties hereto = las partes del presente contrato.

questions.question: The definitions used ____ shall apply throughout the entire agreement. (En este documento).
We ____ notify you that your contract will be terminated. (Por la presente).
A contract that is void from the beginning because it is illegal is considered null and ____.
questions.explanation: Null and void = nulo y sin valor legal.

questions.question: The company accepts no ____ for any damage caused by the misuse of the product. (Responsabilidad legal).
In the event of a dispute, ____ law shall be the law of the State of New York. (Ley aplicable).
questions.explanation: Governing law (o applicable law) = ley aplicable.

questions.question: Any disputes arising from this contract shall be resolved by binding ____, not in court. (Arbitraje).
The rights granted in this agreement may not be transferred or ____ to any third party. (Cedidos).
questions.explanation: Assigned = cedidos (en términos legales, transferir un derecho es 'assign').

questions.question: Failure to enforce a clause does not constitute a ____ of that right. (Renuncia a un derecho).
questions.explanation: Waiver = renuncia legal a un derecho (to waive a right).

questions.question: The period during which the contract is valid is referred to as the ____ of the contract. (Plazo / Duración).
questions.explanation: Term = término, plazo o duración del contrato.

questions.question: A standard clause that is the same in many contracts and protects the drafter is called ____. (Cláusula estándar/texto tipo).
questions.explanation: Boilerplate = texto legal estándar y repetitivo en contratos.

questions.question: If you do not pay within 30 days, you will be in ____. (Mora / Incumplimiento de pago).
questions.explanation: In default = en estado de morosidad o incumplimiento.

questions.question: The formal end of a contract before its expiration date is called ____. (Terminación).
A promise or guarantee made by a seller about the quality of goods is a ____. (Garantía).
questions.explanation: Warranty = garantía legal (también representation and warranties).

questions.question: A material ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
Legally ____. (Vinculante con B)
Non-____ Agreement. (Confidencialidad con D)
Force ____. (Fuerza mayor)
Null and ____. (Nulo con V)
No ____ for damages. (Responsabilidad civil con L)
The ____ clause. (Divisibilidad con S)
I ____ notify you. (Por la presente con H)
Binding ____. (Arbitraje con A)
Standard ____ clauses. (Texto estándar legal con B)
